name: jasonzhu-ai
title: JasonZhu.AI
description: jasonzhu.ai does not run a remote MCP server. There is no MCP endpoint to connect to, so this card lists no transport. What the site offers agents: browser-side WebMCP tools that its pages register via document.modelContext or declarative HTML forms (listed under tools), and plain HTTPS files that need no MCP (listed in instructions).
instructions: Without a browser, read these over plain HTTPS: https://jasonzhu.ai/llms.txt (site guide and citation rules), https://jasonzhu.ai/agents.md (what an agent may and may not do on this site), https://jasonzhu.ai/data/payment-guard.json (payment-platform data with check dates), https://jasonzhu.ai/data/ai-visibility/payments-mor.csv and https://jasonzhu.ai/data/ai-visibility/china-ai-global.csv (monthly AI visibility indices), https://jasonzhu.ai/feed/blog.xml and https://jasonzhu.ai/feed/news.xml (RSS). The tools below exist only inside a jasonzhu.ai page loaded in a browser that supports WebMCP (document.modelContext / declarative <form toolname>). An external MCP client cannot call them through this card.

tools.name: recommend_payment_mor
tools.title: Recommend SaaS Payment / MoR Platforms & Net Payouts
tools.description: WebMCP, registered by a page script. Fetches /data/payment-guard.json and runs pickTable() for a founder's entity and product type, returning deterministic $20 net take-home figures, eligibility, exclusions, and the pre-filtered interactive selector URL.

who.description: Founder entity holding the payout account.

lang.description: Output language for notes and URLs.

tools.name: scan_ai_readiness
tools.title: Run 26-Check AI Readiness & GEO Audit
tools.description: WebMCP, exposed declaratively by the scan form on /{lang}/go-global/ai-readiness (with SubmitEvent.respondWith) and registered imperatively on other pages. Sends POST /api/ai-readiness to probe 26 live HTTP/SEO/GEO signals for a domain and logs the domain in the public clinic directory.

domain.description: Public domain or URL to inspect (e.g. 'stripe.com' or 'jasonzhu.ai').

lang.description: Language preference for the returned report URL.

tools.name: search_jasonzhu_articles
tools.title: Search the link list in llms.txt
tools.description: WebMCP, registered by a page script. Fetches /llms.txt and returns up to 20 of its link lines that contain the keyword, plus the blog URL. It does not search article text.

query.description: Keyword to look for in the link lines of /llms.txt.

lang.description: Language of the returned blog URL.

tools.name: search_jasonzhu_blog
tools.title: Filter the blog list
tools.description: WebMCP, declared by the search form in the page footer. Opens /{lang}/blog?q={keyword}; the page filters its article list in the browser.

q.description: Keyword to filter the blog list by.

tools.name: get_going_global_guides
tools.title: Links to the going-global guides & monthly AI visibility indices
tools.description: WebMCP, registered by a page script. Returns fixed links to the going-global hub, payment selector, AI Readiness Clinic, monthly AI visibility indices, account-opening guide, GoSail Club, and services.
